text.body:
% 34 visarga-like deletion marks in \C, then:
caityaṃ tu kumbhakanakadhānyarāśilatākhyabhedāt yathāsaṃkhyaṃ ṭhakārākṛticūḍikābhakhagāṇḍatilasaṃnibham |
% mchod rten gyi bum pa ni gser dang 'bras kyi phung po dang 'khri shing du grags pa'i dbye bas grangs ji lta ba bzhin du tha yig gi dbyibs dang gtsug tor lta bu {236a4} dang bya'i sgo nga lta bu dang tel lta bu'o ||
caturasre kṛte kṣetre dvādaśabhājite | ekasārdhadvisārdhadvikoṇayor bhāgaharaṇavartanāt bimbaṃ syāt |
% gru bzhi pa'i sa cha la bcu gnyis su byas te phyed dang gnyis dang phyed dang gsum gyi cha zur gnyis su dor nas zlum pa la bum par 'gyur ro ||
bimbārdhe nemikānvitaṃ | bimbārdhapīṭhaṃ | tadvad dharmimastakāntaṃ | bimbāyataṃ chattraṃ |
% bum pa'i phyed kyis ni bang rim du 'gyur zhing bum pa'i phyed kyis ni khri'o || de bzhin du bre dang rtse mo'i mthar te {236a5} sku gzugs kyi dbang gis gdugs so ||
tac caikatrayapañcatrayodaśaṃ saṃbuddhava[\C298\verso]jradharāṇāṃ | navasaptapratyekaśrāvakabuddhayoḥ |
% de yang gcig dang gsum dang lnga dang bcu gsum ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi'o || dgu dang bdun ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi'o ||
avītarāgadhātucaitye padmakalikaiva paraṃ nānyat |
% 'dod chags kyi khams dang ma bral ba rnams kyi mchod rten la ni padma zlum pa lta bu ste gzhan {236a6} du ma yin no ||
tathā bimbābhedena yaṣṭyāropaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ |
% de ltar na sku gzugs kyi dbye bas srog shing gzugs par bya'o ||
caturbuddhāsanaṃ punar vairocanapradhānīkṛtaṃ |
bimbād bāhyacaturbhadre caturbuddhavirājitaṃ |
% sangs rgyas bzhi'i khri dang slar yang rnam par snang mdzad ni gtso bor bya zhing bum pa'i phyi rol bzang po bzhi las sangs rgyas bzhis rnam par mdzes pa'o ||
koṇe stambhārpaṇaṃ kuryāt bodhisattvādibhūṣitaṃ |
cchattrākāraṃ tu yaṣṭyūrdhvaṃ varṣāsthālakasaṃjñakaṃ |
% zur la ka bas bteg pa bya zhing byang chub sems {236a7} dpa' la sogs pas brgyan pa'o || gdugs kyi rnam pa ni srog shing gi steng du ste char khebs kyi ming can no ||
hārārdhahāraghaṇṭādikiṅkiṇījālabhūṣitaṃ |
tadūrdhvaṃ ca maṇiḥ kāryaṃ padmakalikā tu kecit |
vidhinā lakṣaṇopetaṃ kārayed vidhikovidaḥ |
% do shal dang do shal phyed pa dang dril bu la sogs pa dang g-yer kha'i drabs brgyan pa'o || de'i steng du nor bu bya ste padma zlum pa ni mthar ro zhes pa ni kha cig gi'o || cho ga mtshan {236b1} nyid dang ldan pa bya ste cho ga rim pa rnams kyis so
iti caityalakṣaṇavidhiḥ || ||
% zhes pa mchod rten gyi mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'o ||
